div.div: λειπανδρία and other compds. freq. written in medieval Mss. with λειπ- (λειπο-, λειφ-) will be found, with few exceptions, under λῐπ (λῐπο-, λῐφ-): metrical evidence, where available, favours λῐπ-, which is also certain in λιποτελέω: but λειπ- is certain in λειπογνώμων, and for many other words no trustworthy evidence of the spelling exists; cf. Choerob.in An.Ox. 2.239 .
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
